build_causal_graph: build a causal graph with latent variables for the Adult dataset using PSCF counterfactual fairness
build_forward_fn: build the forward pass function that computes log likelihood and fair inference for causal model
build_input: build a TensorFlow data input pipeline from a pandas DataFrame with batching and shuffling
run_training: run the PSCF causal model training loop on the Adult dataset with configurable hyperparameters
evaluate_fair_inference: evaluate fair and unfair predictions by comparing counterfactual outcomes against baseline gender values
